traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Assuming Indika is a primary source; it is actually known through fragments in later works.
Confusing Ashoka's Puranic mentions with contemporary Mauryan literary evidence.
Over-reliance on Arthashastra as a literal account of reality; it is a normative (prescriptive) text, not descriptive.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Secular Sources

  • Arthashastra (Kautilya)
  • Indika (Megasthenes)
  • Mudrarakshasa (Vishakhadatta)

Religious Sources

  • Buddhist: Dipavamsa, Mahavamsa
  • Jain: Parishishtaparvan
  • Puranic: Dynastic lists

Core Literary Categorization

  • Arthashastra: Focuses on Saptanga theory, espionage, and taxation.
  • Indika: Describes the 7-fold caste system and administrative city committees.
  • Mudrarakshasa: Dramatizes the struggle of Chanakya against the Nandas to install Chandragupta.
